samples.scope: standalone CsvAdapter writer; no Job, index or Blueprint

business.scope: all business components, row sequence, exact ns time type/value and duplicate ingestion order; ignores SDK clocks/IDs and chunk boundaries

memory.method: psutil process RSS polling; includes native allocations
memory.scope: this process; child processes and system page cache are excluded

resource_sampling.scope: parent process resource sampling; owned tabular-sort.sqlite and journals; excludes RRD output, SDK validation files and SQLite native temporary I/O

acceptance.comparison_scope: single path integrity/stress only; no paired parity claim
